title: DATE ( 2008, 1, 0 ) is an error

source.quote: If Day is 0, DATE returns an error.
source.supports: DAX Guide documents day 0 as an error

source.quote: Negative integers are not supported. Valid values are 1-31.
source.supports: Microsoft Learn calls only 1 to 31 valid

derivation: DAX Guide states that day 0 is an error, while a negative day goes back from the first day of the month.
alternative: In Excel, day 0 is the last day of the previous month: the result would be 2007-12-31T00:00:00.
